notes.title: Revitalization Update V0.0.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004012/5c40756d9e1014aba62367fe49acad8bff9f3f0e.gif

Finally, the update is here! Let's dive in and I'll explain what's been added to the game from this point on.

Therefore, I'm going to start by talking about the Elteria Hunter; I'm currently working on creating a large game that will be receiving updates on a weekly and bi-weekly basis. This will bring large and small changes to the game, in addition to adding some fantastic new features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004012/29ecb3b00ae3fa1ae4f6f0985a8bedf1c9d23b1c.png

In the above picture, you can see the initial region map. This map will have a variety of islands to explore and it will be quite large so it will take some time to complete all of the content for each map. Therefore, there will be quite a bit to do in-game.

At the game's full release, two islands will have already been unlocked. In later updates, I'll add more opportunities to the game and unlock the other parts of the maps as post-game content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004012/3160cbd22dfd56b5105ea220f81dac06977c5980.gif

Looking at the image above, you can see that all the monsters in the game will be animated to give more life to the world and battles. This will also introduce different types of monsters, such as normal and alpha monsters, and in the future, even more types with more powerful abilities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004012/8c491dd7657cf17960c95ff6a2943f815ee5b5cb.gif

To begin with, the most recognizable system I've chosen to use is RPG Maker since I'm a fan of the classic style and I want to combine it with modern mechanics found in most games today. 
I will have more of an opportunity to invest in creating enhanced mechanics to enhance the gaming experience since I can find a majority of world-building elements in RPG Maker and create them myself.

To start, I'm implementing crafting and armor systems, as well as different types of monsters. This will add a lot to the game and story, as it will have a narrative that you'll discover through the quest journal.

I hope all of you can enjoy this update and if there are any bugs or other issues, please submit them on our new Discord page. This is also the place for anyone who wants to have a conversation with me about the game's future. I'll be creating a roadmap of upcoming updates to share with you all soon.

Discord: https://discord.gg/Ya9KwQmy34

notes.title: Upcoming Update V0.0.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004012/5c40756d9e1014aba62367fe49acad8bff9f3f0e.gif

Hi Hunters,

Currently I am finishing the concluding components of the map and tale for an enhanced gaming loop, plus introducing strengthened player and monster attributes to make the early game feel more vibrant and better than prior game versions. This will make the game significantly more enjoyable, and bring a higher level of difficulty. Moreover, it will help you calculate the best way to use your team for the battle.

As a result of having already played the prior version, you will recognize a multitude of systems in the game, however, they lack emotion; so, commencing from this moment, every system will have a substantial impact on the gameplay, particularly the quest system. There will be a vast number of main and side quests to undertake.

The crafting system will undergo a significant overhaul as well, and I will provide further details in upcoming updates.

Currently, I am devoting considerable effort to executing a great number of advantageous improvements to drastically enhance the gameplay.

I am currently making significant changes to the game, the most significant being that the majority of the game will take place within a large open-world connected by two or three major maps. This will give the game more depth, and make it easier for me to create an engaging story, as well as incorporate world bosses, dungeons, and more. Please pay attention to these updates.

When the game is launched tomorrow, an official Discord server will be unveiled. This can be accessed through the game or via the Steam page. Everybody is welcome to join the chat about the game and its future.

I hope everyone has a pleasant day and await the release of Elteria Hunter tomorrow.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004012/2ee891dd94f66669c680411b0c857f8ed0b1348e.gif

notes.title: Upcoming Game Release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004012/a0582e2f1581ce4f39b6c6b11be9a2b9cc1b93ca.gif

Glad to come back with information to share with you - check out the store page and you'll see all the updates I posted are no longer there, we are starting from scratch on making a wonderful RPG role play game and I'm delighted to tell you that we'll be releasing the first part of this new chapter this coming Sunday so you can start enjoying the new and incredible Elteria Hunter.

When beginning the game, you will be able to explore the first portion of the open world. The game won't be as easy as before, but it will have enhanced mechanics and gameplay - keep an eye out for its release.

So for now Hunters, enjoy your day and i will see you all this coming Sunday!
